title: Registry Entry Schema
description: Schema for compiled constitution registry entries (data/constitutions/registry/*.json). Legacy entries carry only the core fields; entries intended for Creed Commons distribution additionally carry the distribution block. Publishability is gated on the presence of `namespace` — entries without it are valid locally but never published.

id.description: Unique identifier (snake_case), matches the source constitution id

content_hash.description: sha256 of the source constitution at compile time (legacy field)

namespace.description: Distribution namespace (e.g. creed-space). Presence marks the entry as publishable; absence means legacy/local-only. The publish lint additionally enforces the launch allowlist.

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the distributed artifact bytes; pinned by vcp install into the lockfile and re-checked by vcp verify

trust_tier.description: signed = signature + hash + schema verified, semantics NOT vouched for. verified = additionally linted, red-teamed, and counter-signed by Creed Space. MVP ships only signed; never present signed as verified.

signatures.description: Signature scheme -> signer key id. Must be non-empty: unsigned artifacts are never published.

source_repo.description: URL of the repository the artifact was published from

artifact.description: Filename of the distributed artifact within the version directory (e.g. anti_gaslighting.md)

eval_evidence.description: Optional pointers to evaluation evidence (reports, benchmark runs)

namespace.description: A publishable entry must carry the full distribution block
